caption_latex: Passive-relay control for weak-end loss and $J_b=0.25\omega_c$. {(a):} Endpoint concurrence $\mathcal C_{13}$ versus $\omega_ct$ for the full three-spin chain (``With spin 2'') and a two-spin, three-cavity chain in which spin 2 is absent from the start (``Cavity only''). Physical endpoints retain labels 1 and 3, and the middle cavity remains in both models. The main full-chain curve is the cavity reference; its fine dotted curve and pointwise 95\% band are the HOPS estimate. The passive-relay curve is deterministic. The other parameters are those of main Fig.~1, and no measurement or feedback is applied.
